name: navex/workspace
description: Generic coverage (contract/smoke) test for navex/workspace on the setup page. For each method: collects required args by walking the compose tree, uses a curated override when one exists else synthesizes defaults, EXECUTES the method against the live DOM, and type-checks the return value against the declared returnType. For each public element: resolves it against the live DOM and binds its capability. This proves the page-object↔DOM binding works against a real org. It does NOT assert behavioral outcomes (navigation, state changes, value contents); parameterized actions without a curated arg value are Skipped (see each step's `verification` parameter and skip reasons) rather than driven with a placeholder.
